entry.title: feat: implement core editor functionality with swap and recovery support

feat: implement core editor functionality with swap and recovery support
- Add `Buffer` for on-demand file I/O, delta management, and swap file persistence. - Implement `Editor` state machine for navigation and mode switching. - Add swap file detection and recovery prompts to `main.rs`. - Implement basic text editing (Insert mode) and atomic saving. - Update `README.md` with new features and roadmap progress.
